Young New Zealand of the Year 2023

about_teaser.heading: Doing good projects with good people
about_teaser.body:
Sam brings people together and makes great things happen, and has started and scaled a mix of charities, businesses and ideas to that end. He loves working with smart people and can intuitively see opportunities to help others make their vision come true.

For the last ten years, he has worked to create stronger social infrastructure and resilience through an organisation he founded called SVA (Student Volunteer Army). As Chief Executive, he grew the team, funding and programmes to impact thousands of young people’s lives and designed community responses to many major crises and disasters that earned his team several awards.

copy.newsletter_body: Occasional updates on Sam's projects, speaking dates and the SVA — no noise.
copy.speaking_body: Sam speaks to schools, companies, conferences and governments about mobilising people, leading through crisis, and trusting young people with real responsibility.
